summary: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes Stripe functionality to AI agents and tools. It wraps the Stripe API so payment and billing operations can be invoked programmatically, and is launched as a command-line server process.

nodes.title: Backend
nodes.notes: MCP server (server.py) that defines and serves tools/handlers, orchestrating Stripe operations for AI clients

nodes.title: Integrations
nodes.notes: Connects to the external Stripe API for payments/billing; LiteLLM used for LLM calls

nodes.title: CLI
nodes.notes: stripe-mcp command-line entry point (__main__.py) that boots and runs the server
